title: Spotter
tagline: Camera-first nutritional tracking on iOS, powered by LiDAR and multimodal LLMs
description: Consumer iOS app that turns the iPhone Pro LiDAR sensor and GPT-4o into a single-scan food coach. Swift, ARKit, Core ML on-device classification, server-side multimodal reasoning. Shipped on the App Store.

title: RGB-D Nutritional Pipeline (TFG)
tagline: Research-grade portion estimation pipeline fusing LiDAR depth with multimodal reasoning
description: Undergraduate thesis at UC3M. Advanced computer vision pipeline that fuses RGB-D scans from iPhone LiDAR with GPT-4o reasoning to estimate food volume and macros at research-grade accuracy. Uses the Spotter app as research interface.

title: Enterprise GenAI Assistant
tagline: Production multi-LLM platform at Beam Suntory, sanitized case study
description: Internal GenAI assistant at Beam Suntory. Retrieval over enterprise knowledge with multi-provider LLM routing, evaluation harness, and full observability. Sanitized: no product names, no real metrics, no real screenshots.

title: AISC Madrid
tagline: Co-founded Madrid's largest student-run AI community
description: Co-founder and Director of Events at AISC Madrid. First AISC chapter in Europe, first student AI association at UC3M. Talks, workshops, hackathons, mentorship. Bridge between academia and the Madrid AI hiring market.

title: BearHack — Bad Posture Detection
tagline: 3rd place at UCR Hackathon, real-time posture monitoring with computer vision
description: Hackathon project at UC Riverside. Computer vision pipeline detecting bad posture from webcam feeds in real time. 3rd place winner.
